kaikki_vikisozluk.t: Borrowed from Aramaic נָטוֹרָא / ܢܳܛܘܰܪܐ (nāṭōrā, “watchman”), originally borrowed as a field-guard in agriculture. Doublet of نَاظُور (nāẓūr, “field glasses”).
g: somebody who watches over things, watchman, lookout, caretaker, concierge, storage room guy, warden, janitor, etc.
